item.title: A man from Mountain Home has been arrested for allegedly stabbing another man.
item.description: 51-year-old Andrew Melton was arrested for allegedly stabbing a 56-year-old man. The man was transported to the Hospital. Melton is charged with aggravated residential burglary and second-degree battery. He was taken to the Baxter County Detention Center.

item.title: Akshay Bhatia wins the Arnold Palmer Invitational
item.description: AKshay Bhatia beat Daniel Berger in a playoff to win the Arnold Palmer Invitational at Bay Hill Country Club on Sunday. Bhatia came from five strokes down on the back nine to tie Berger at 15 under.
